holdings.subsector: Distributed solar, battery storage, and EV charging infrastructure
holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Actis invests via its energy infrastructure strategy in distributed generation, storage, and EV charging platforms; Catalyze is explicitly described as a distributed solar and clean energy infrastructure platform.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: Catalyze is a U.S.-based distributed energy platform with nationwide operations across multiple U.S. states.

evidence.title: Catalyze — Actis Portfolio
evidence.evidenceSummary: Actis lists Catalyze as a current portfolio company in distributed solar and battery storage with U.S. operations.

evidence.title: Actis and EnCap invest in US solar platform Catalyze
evidence.evidenceSummary: Actis Energy 5 acquires a co-control stake in Catalyze alongside EnCap, confirming ownership, strategy, and investment year.

evidence.title: Catalyze About Us
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms Catalyze is a U.S.-based company headquartered in Houston with distributed energy operations across the United States.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: Repository omits disclosed co-control stake and misstates headquarters as multi-state operations rather than Houston; these are material ownership/geography details.

holdings.subsector: Independent power generation and gas transportation
holdings.infrastructureStrategyBasis: Actis invests in long-life power and gas infrastructure assets; Valia Energía is a large-scale Mexican power generation and gas transport platform.
holdings.northAmericaBasis: Valia operates entirely within Mexico with multiple power plants and gas infrastructure assets.

evidence.title: Valia Energía — Actis Portfolio
evidence.evidenceSummary: Actis lists Valia Energía as a current Mexican power generation platform within its infrastructure portfolio.

evidence.title: Actis completes acquisition of MT Falcon
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms Actis Energy 5 acquired the Mexican power platform that became Valia Energía.

evidence.title: Valia Energía Website
evidence.evidenceSummary: Confirms Valia operates power plants and infrastructure across Mexico with headquarters in Mexico City.

holdings.repoDispositionRationale: Repository misstates headquarters and omits updated platform scale; geography field reflects asset locations rather than corporate HQ.

excludedCandidates.rationale: Actis defines TERRANOVA as a Latin American hyperscale data center platform spanning Brazil, Mexico, and Chile; it is not primarily based in or dedicated to North America despite initial Mexican operations.
NextStream is an Americas data center platform with assets across six countries and only limited U.S. exposure; it is not primarily North American.
Actis exited Atlas Renewable Energy in 2022 via sale to Global Infrastructure Partners.
Actis sold its Mexican power platform Saavi Energía (InterGen Mexico) prior to creation of Valia; no longer held.
Actis exited Zuma Energía in Mexico through a sale to SPIC in 2020.

repoOnlyRecords.rationale: Platform is explicitly Latin American (Brazil, Mexico, Chile) and not primarily North American.
